title: When the Launch Date Meets a Critical Bug
meta: B2 · 约 270 词 · 场景：上线决策

sections.heading: 1. The False Choice
paragraphs: It is the day before launch, and QA finds a bug that corrupts saved drafts for some users.
Marketing has already announced the date, and the press release is scheduled.
The room quickly splits into two camps: ship anyway, or ==postpone== everything.
This is almost always a false choice.
Between shipping everything and shipping nothing, there is usually a middle path.
You can launch with the broken feature switched off, release to a small ==segment== of users, or ship on time with a known ==workaround==.
**When someone offers you two options under pressure, look for the third one.**
The best answer often keeps the date and removes the risk, rather than trading one for the other.
Finding it takes ten minutes of calm thinking, which is exactly what panic __crowds out__.
paragraphs_zh: 上线前一天，QA 发现了一个 bug，会把部分用户保存的草稿搞坏。
市场那边已经官宣了日期，新闻稿也排好了。
屋里很快分成两派：硬着头皮上，还是全部延期。
这几乎总是一个假的二选一。
在全上和全不上之间，通常还有一条中间路线。
你可以把有问题的功能关掉再上线，先放给一小部分用户，或者按时上线并给出一个已知的绕过办法。
当有人在压力下只给你两个选项时，去找第三个。
最好的答案往往是既保住日期又消掉风险，而不是拿一个去换另一个。
找到它只需要十分钟冷静思考，而这恰恰是慌乱时最容易被挤掉的东西。

sections.heading: 2. Bring Options, Not Just Bad News
paragraphs: When you take the problem to your manager or the PM, don't just __drop the bug on the table__.
Bring two or three options, each with a clear ==tradeoff==.
Keep the message short enough to read on a phone between meetings.
Option one: ship tomorrow with drafts disabled, and lose that feature for a week.
Option two: ship tomorrow to five percent of users, and accept a small risk of data loss.
Option three: slip by three days and ship everything ==intact==.
**Then say which one you recommend, and why.**
Decision makers want your judgment, not just a menu.
A clear ==recommendation== also makes it easier for them to __push back__ if they see a factor you missed, like a contract that depends on the date.
Either way, the decision gets made in minutes instead of hours.
sections.heading_zh: 2. 带着方案来，而不只是坏消息
paragraphs_zh: 当你把问题拿给经理或 PM 的时候，别只是把 bug 往桌上一扔。
带上两三个方案，每个都讲清楚取舍。
消息要短，短到对方能在两个会之间用手机看完。
方案一：明天上线，草稿功能关掉，这个功能缺一周。
方案二：明天放给百分之五的用户，接受一点数据丢失的风险。
方案三：推迟三天，所有功能完整上线。
然后说清楚你推荐哪个，以及为什么。
做决定的人要的是你的判断，而不只是一张菜单。
一个明确的建议也让他们更容易提出反对，比如他们看到了你漏掉的因素，像是有份合同依赖这个日期。
不管怎样，决定都能在几分钟内做出来，而不是拖上几个小时。

gist.q: 上线前一天发现严重 bug，团队通常分成哪两派？作者怎么看？
gist.a: 一派照常上线、一派全部推迟；作者认为这是伪二选一，中间往往有第三条路。

gist.q: 文中提到了哪些“中间路径”？
gist.a: 关掉有问题的功能上线、只对一小部分用户发布、带着已知的绕过方案按时上线。

gist.q: 向经理或 PM 汇报时应该怎么做？
gist.a: 带两三个选项并说清各自代价，然后给出自己的推荐和理由，方便对方快速决定或反驳。

Then say which one you recommend, and why.

prompts.q: 明天上线，今晚发现导出功能有严重 bug。用 30 秒向你的总监汇报：给出三个选项和你的推荐。
prompts.ref: Quick heads-up on tomorrow's launch. QA found a bug that can corrupt exported reports. We have three options. One, launch on time with export turned off for about a week. Two, launch to ten percent of users with export on and watch closely. Three, slip by three days. I recommend option one: the date holds, and export is a minor part of the release. Does anything make the date less important than I think?
prompts.ref_zh: 同步一下明天上线的事。QA 发现了一个 bug，可能会把导出的报表搞坏。我们有三个方案。一，按时上线，导出功能关掉大概一周。二，放给百分之十的用户，导出打开，密切盯着。三，推迟三天。我建议方案一：日期保住了，而且导出只是这次发布里很小的一部分。有没有什么情况，让这个日期没我想的那么重要？

prompts.q: 会上大家在“硬上”还是“全推迟”之间吵起来了。用 30 秒打断，引导大家找第三条路。
prompts.ref: Can I pause us for a second? We're arguing as if there are only two choices, ship everything or ship nothing. I don't think that's true. The bug only affects the sync feature. What if we launch tomorrow with sync behind a flag, and turn it on once the fix is verified? Let's spend five minutes listing middle options before we pick a side.
prompts.ref_zh: 我能让大家先停一下吗？我们现在吵得好像只有两个选择，要么全上，要么全不上。我觉得不是这样。这个 bug 只影响同步功能。要不明天上线，把同步藏在开关后面，等修复验证完再打开？我们先花五分钟把中间方案列一列，再来选边站。

words.ex: We had to postpone the launch because of the payment bug.
Let's release it to a small segment of users in one market first.
Support can share the workaround until the fix is out.
The tradeoff is faster delivery but less test coverage.
After the migration, all user settings were intact.
My recommendation is to delay the rollout by one week.
A race condition corrupted a few user profiles last night.
The team is split into two camps on the migration plan.
I trust your judgment on which tests we can skip.
